visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal slider of listing or blog cards with arrows and n of N counter
descriptions: Left-aligned H2 with prev/next arrows and '1 of 16' counter; horizontal slider of image cards (Sponsored badge, favorite heart, H3 title, short text, Read More link), third card faded at the edge.
Same slider pattern as Unique Orlando Experiences: H2 with arrows and '1 of 9'; cards with image, outlined category tag pills, H3 title, text and Read More link.

contentPattern.structure: image cell | text cell (optional "Sponsored" paragraph, optional tag list, title heading, text, Read More link)
rows: text: title heading, description, CTA link

usage.description: 16 listing cards in a slider: image, H3 title, description, Read More link to a listing detail page
9 blog post cards in a slider: image, category tags, H3 title, excerpt, Read More link to the post

reuseGuidance: Use for long lists of linked cards that should scroll horizontally.
